fittingMethod: Recency-weighted ridge regression with partially pooled candidate intercepts; separate Senate/governor fits. Candidate residuals reflect opponents and turnout too, not identified personal causal effects.
nationalEnvironment: Current generic ballot margin. Approval shown as context; a hypothetical approval change adjusts the scenario environment only, without counting baseline approval twice.
validationCaveat: Forward-year conditional diagnostics use realized national House popular vote, which was not known in advance. This is not an end-to-end ex-ante forecast backtest or calibration of win probabilities. Shrinkage selected on 2010–2020 only; 2022/2024 are held-out cycles.
